entries.title: Evolution, Mega Plates & Battle Effects Update
changes: This update significantly expands the Evolution and Plate systems, completes additional Mega Evolution Plate support, improves persistent battle effects, polishes the Team Builder and Libraries, and fixes multiple gameplay interactions reported by players.
🧬 EVOLUTION
Improved the Evolution system to correctly follow each Pokémon's evolution chain.
Pokémon can no longer skip evolution stages when multiple stages are available in their evolution chain.
Pokémon now evolve after eligible battle victories, while draws do not trigger Evolution.
Improved Evolution, Devolution and form-change handling throughout battle.
Evolution and Devolution now correctly remove applicable special conditions and markers from the Pokémon.
Improved after-battle sequencing so Evolution and Abilities activate in the correct order.
Improved Evolution interactions involving Pokémon with special Evolution-related Abilities.
Improved Rare Candy interactions with Pokémon that can evolve.
💎 MEGA EVOLUTION & MEGA PLATES
Improved Mega Evolution Plate support throughout the game.
Standardized Mega Evolution Plates to use their correct 7-turn Mega Evolution duration.
Mega Evolution Plates can only be used while none of the player's Pokémon are currently Mega Evolved.
Mega Evolution Plates now correctly target the matching Pokémon on the field.
Mega Plates in the Team Builder are only available when the team contains a compatible Pokémon.
Mega Evolution and Devolution now correctly remove applicable special conditions and markers.
Mega Pokémon correctly return to their normal form when their Mega Evolution duration expires.
Improved Mega Evolution interactions with Pokémon Abilities that activate when a Mega Pokémon appears.
Completed support for additional Mega Evolution Plates, including Abomasite, Absolite, Aerodactylite, Banettite, Garchompite, Heracronite, Manectite, Pinsirite and Sharpedonite.
🃏 PLATES & LASTING EFFECTS
Completed support for additional remaining Plate effects.
Improved how active Plate effects are displayed during battles.
Added persistent Plate and Sphere aura indicators that remain visible throughout the battle instead of appearing only when battle moves are displayed.
Plate and Sphere indicators now appear on the side of the Pokémon affected by the effect.
Added support for displaying multiple active aura effects on the same Pokémon.
Additional aura indicators automatically wrap onto another row instead of extending into the opponent's side.
Hovering an active Plate or Sphere indicator now displays information about its effect.
Improved tracking and presentation of lasting battle effects such as Spheres and Trick Room.
Fixed cases where persistent battle effects could disappear after their initial activation.
⚔️ BATTLE & GAMEPLAY
Fixed several move and Ability interactions reported by players that were not activating their intended effects.
Improved handling of Pokémon affected by persistent battle effects.
Improved several movement, Ability and special move interactions to better match the original Pokémon Duel rules.
Improved consistency of effects that modify or interact with Pokémon wheels.
Improved handling of special effects that activate before, during and after battles.
Improved interactions between battle results, passive Abilities and form changes.
🎨 BATTLE UI
Improved the positioning of persistent effects around the two battle wheels.
Adjusted the battle layout so both players have equal space on each side of the screen.
Improved active-effect visibility during wheel battles.
Added clearer separation between effects belonging to each Pokémon.
Improved stacking behavior when several persistent effects are active simultaneously.
Persistent Plate and Sphere indicators now remain visible even while the battle moves are not being displayed.
Improved hover information for active battle effects.
👥 TEAM BUILDER
Standardized the Team Builder layout and spacing.
Online and Offline Team Builders now use consistent positioning and margins.
Improved top and bottom spacing throughout the Team Builder.
Adjusted title and content positioning to better match the rest of the game's menus.
Improved handling of Mega Plates based on the Pokémon currently included in a team.
📚 LIBRARIES
Improved consistency between the Figure Library and Plate Library layouts.
Moved Library Back buttons to the bottom of the screen.
Standardized top and bottom margins across Library screens.
Improved overall spacing and positioning to better match the rest of the game's interface.
